Lead: CTO (Ana Ribeiro) -> strong emphasis on per-language quality. Use-case: e-discovery + cross-border compliance search across English, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese. Wants single inference layer for hosted dev then transition to Private (VPC/on-prem) for EU data residency.

PIECES FROM CALLS:
- 'We need per-language recall within 3-5% of English baseline' — Ana Ribeiro (2026-01-15).
- Interested in embeddings + reranker hybrid: dense retrieval for recall, light-weight neural reranker for precision on top-50.
- Cost constraint: target < $0.05/query avg (including embed + rerank).

TECH/REQUIREMENTS SUMMARY:
- Indexing scale: start POC 50M documents (legal opinions, contracts, transcripts).
- Shard/replica concerns: want predictable tail latency for cross-lingual reranking (p95 under 1s).
- Per-language tuning: need separate embedding models or language-aware normalization; measuring per-language recall/precision per release.
- Model preferences: open models preferred (cost), willing to test small supervised reranker on dedicated infra.
- Routing/fallback: prefer routing EU traffic to private nodes, fallback to dedicated hosted pool if capacity issues.

SECURITY/COMPLIANCE:
- SOC2 in procurement pack required. ISO27001 requested.
- KMS + HSM for key management; strict retention controls for legal holds.

SALES/OPS NOTES:
- Demo Jan 15 recorded (ff_20260115_8472). Follow-up: deliver cost model for embed+rerank at different index sizes (1M/10M/50M).
- AE to provide test plan for per-language recall matrix and tuned reranker pipeline.
- Procurement request: must include on-prem pricing option and lead time for Dedicated nodes.
